[1/5] Plan: Syndicate job board - three rotating offers, accept/decline choice, offer shelf life, deadline start on acceptance, CLI/Web/API surfaces, tests, ADR-021

impact_assessment.why: The contract market still auto-assigns a single job, so risk tiers and givers are not a player choice. An offer board adds autonomy, makes risk/reward selection legible, and gives declining a real broker-relationship cost.
impact_assessment.benefits: Players choose risk tier, objective, target, and giver; offers rotate on the clock; active jobs still have a hard deadline; trust remains the payout/deadline currency.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: GameState.contract_offers additive; BountyContract gains offer/accept fields; completing or expiring a job now leaves active_contract None until acceptance; existing tests that assume auto-dispatch need updating; dependency: none; concurrency: server mutations stay under the session lock; state: offers persist and must default for old saves
impact_assessment.mitigation: Backward-compatible defaults, a single offer generator reused by initial/refresh paths, explicit lifecycle tests, CLI/API tests, full discover after each milestone, and ADR-021.
